lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん」
lines.english: “Big Brother.”

lines.japanese: 「あい？」
lines.english: “Yeah?”

lines.japanese: なんかよく分かんないけど、おきたら小ばとがよんでた。
lines.english: I dunno what was going on, but when I woke up, Kobato was calling me.

lines.japanese: いたのは小ばとだけじゃなくて、あとふたりいた。小ばとの友だちみたい。
lines.english: She wasn't alone. There were two other people too. Looked like friends of hers.

lines.japanese: 「すみませんお兄さん、ちょっといいですか？」
lines.english: “Excuse me, mister. Do you have a minute?”

lines.japanese: 「ドラ、あなたは聞くとよい、この話を」
lines.english: “Dora, it is good for you to listen to this story.”

lines.japanese: 「おー、おー」
lines.english: “Sure, sure.”

lines.japanese: おれの知らないあいだに、小ばとはいっぱい友だち作ってたみたい。
lines.english: Looked like Kobato had made lots of friends while I wasn't around.

lines.japanese: いままで小ばとはずーっとおれがひとりで守ってたから、ちょっとさびしい気ぃもした。
lines.english: Before now, I'd always been the only one protecting her, so it made me feel kinda lonely.

lines.japanese: でも友だちができて小ばとが楽しいんだったら、ぜったいそっちのがいいから、やっぱよかった気ぃする。
lines.english: But if having friends made Kobato happy, then that was definitely better. So I guess it was good after all.

lines.japanese: おれは夢テレビとかあるし、コンドルさんも待ってるから全ぜんへーき。
lines.english: I had Dream TV, and Condor was waiting for me, so I was totally fine.

lines.japanese: やったやった！　友だちできたよ、小ばとやったね！
lines.english: Hooray, hooray! You made friends, Kobato! Way to go!

lines.japanese: 「みんな、ゆっくりしてってねー。うちン家あんまおもちゃとかないけどさ、ポッポはいい子だから仲よくしてあげてねー」
lines.english: “Make yourselves at home, everybody! We don't have many toys, but Poppo's a good kid, so be nice to her!”

lines.japanese: 「お、お兄ちゃんそんなことより！　ほら、ほらっ」
lines.english: “B-Big Brother, never mind that! Look! Look!”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあーん！　プレゼント～！」
lines.english: “Ta-da! A present!”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　うそ！」
lines.english: “What? No way!”

lines.japanese: 「三人でケーキを作ったんです。味は自信ないんですけど、一生懸命がんばりました」
lines.english: “The three of us made you a cake. We aren't confident about the taste, but we tried our very hardest.”

lines.japanese: でーんって、おれの前にまん丸いチョコケーキおかれた。チョーあまそうで、ちょーおいしそう。こんなの作れちゃうなんて、いがいと女子もすげえ。
lines.english: They set a big, round chocolate cake down in front of me with a thump. It looked super sweet and super delicious. I hadn't expected it, but girls were pretty amazing if they could make something like this.

lines.japanese: 「おひょー！　兄ちゃんケーキ大好きだいねー！」
lines.english: “Woo-hoo! Big Brother loooves cake!”

lines.japanese: 「え、でもなんで？　おれ、たんじょう日きょうじゃないよ？」
lines.english: “But why? Today's not my birthday.”

lines.japanese: 「うん。ちょっと遅れちゃったけど、えへへ、これバレンタインチョコなの」
lines.english: “Yeah. It's a little late, but, hee-hee, this is your Valentine's chocolate.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: バレンタイン……？
lines.english: Valentine's...?

lines.japanese: って、いつだっけ？
lines.english: When was that again?

lines.japanese: ２月１４日？　あれ？　先週だっけ？
lines.english: February 14? Wait. Was that last week?

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと張りきりすぎて遅くなっちゃった。ごめんねお兄ちゃん」
lines.english: “We got a little too ambitious, so it took longer than we expected. Sorry, Big Brother.”

lines.japanese: バレンタイン・デー……か。
lines.english: Valentine's Day...

lines.japanese: ああ、そうか。
lines.english: Oh, right.

lines.japanese: そういや先週──１４日にもらってなかったな、小鳩からのチョコ。
lines.english: Come to think of it, I hadn't gotten any chocolate from Kobato last week on the fourteenth.
“Oh.”

lines.japanese: やべ、なんか思いだした……。
lines.english: Crap. I just remembered something...

lines.japanese: そうだ、バレンタインデーだ。
lines.english: Right. Valentine's Day.

lines.japanese: あの日はたしか、うちのかわいい妹がいつチョコを出してくるものかと、一日中わくわくしながら待っていたのに……
lines.english: That whole day, I'd waited excitedly for my adorable little sister to finally bring out my chocolate...

lines.japanese: いたのに……
lines.english: And waited...

lines.japanese: 冷やかし連中の義理チョコばかり溜まって……
lines.english: All I got was obligatory chocolate from people messing with me...

lines.japanese: 肝心の相手からはもらえず……
lines.english: And nothing from the one person who mattered...

lines.japanese: 地味にショックを受けてたんだ。
lines.english: It had actually hurt.

lines.japanese: あー、そうだった……記憶からすっぽり抜けてたわあ……。
lines.english: Oh, right... That memory had fallen clean out of my head...

lines.japanese: うん、そうだよ、あの辺りから記憶の不整合が始まったんだ。
lines.english: Yeah. That was around the time the inconsistencies in my memory began.

lines.japanese: 「てことは、つまり──」
lines.english: “So that means—”

lines.japanese: ──このところ俺が不調だった原因は、小鳩からチョコをもらえなかったこと、か。
lines.english: —the reason I'd been malfunctioning lately was that Kobato hadn't given me chocolate.

lines.japanese: あー、なるほど。だから今、こうしてチョコもらった瞬間に統合が安定したってわけか。
lines.english: Oh, I see. And that was why our integration stabilized the instant I received it now.

lines.japanese: 「おいおい、カッコ悪いな俺！　ははははは！」
lines.english: “God, I'm pathetic! Ha-ha-ha-ha!”

lines.japanese: 「ドラ、私は食べたいケーキ、一刻も早く」
lines.english: “Dora, I want to eat the cake. At the earliest possible moment.”

lines.japanese: 「おう、そうだな。じゃあみんなで食おう！」
lines.english: “Yeah, good idea. Let's all eat!”

lines.japanese: 「はい。それじゃ人数分に切りわけますね」
lines.english: “Okay. I'll cut enough pieces for everybody.”

lines.japanese: 「えーっと、お兄ちゃんたちと、私たち三人で……八等分か」
lines.english: “Let's see. All you guys and the three of us... Eight pieces.”

lines.japanese: 「はち？」
lines.english: “Eight?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あああー、違った、よん！　四等分！」
lines.english: “Oh! N-no, four! Four pieces!”

lines.japanese: 「ひゃあっ！　言われたから八等分しちゃいましたあ」
lines.english: “Eek! You said eight, so I cut eight!”

lines.japanese: 「ははは！　おいおい、みんなドジっ子だなあ！　ようし、俺も負けないぞう、ウラッシャアアア！　へべらっしゃああああ！」
lines.english: “Ha-ha-ha! You're all a bunch of klutzes! Fine, I won't lose either! Ura-shaaaa! Hebe-rashaaaa!”

lines.japanese: 「きゃあああ！　やめてー、無駄に暴れないでー！」
lines.english: “Aaaaaah! Stop! Don't thrash around for no reason!”

lines.japanese: あっはっは。
lines.english: Ah-ha-ha.

lines.japanese: ああ、和むなあ、この子たち。
lines.english: These girls warmed the heart.

lines.japanese: こうして俺は、この冬一番の寒い日を、体の芯まで温まる声に包まれて過ごしましたとさ。
lines.english: And so, on the coldest day of that winter, I passed the hours wrapped in voices that warmed me to the core.

lines.japanese: めでたし、めでたし。
lines.english: And they all lived happily ever after.

lines.japanese: あ、でもべつに俺、シスコンとかロリコンとか全然ないけどね。
lines.english: Oh, but I didn't have a sister complex or any interest in little girls.
